# Somnia

> Somnia is a visual web design studio in development: a real browser canvas, clean HTML and CSS you own, and (planned) an AI that sees your design. It is positioned as a modern Dreamweaver alternative. Status: concept in development. Only a browser prototype (Phase 0) exists. There is no native app, installer, price or license yet.

Made by Philipp Paulik (https://philipp-paulik.de/).

## Pages

- [About Somnia](https://somnia.philipp-paulik.de/about/): vision, principles, features, honest status, roadmap and FAQ.
- [Phase 0 prototype](https://somnia.philipp-paulik.de/): working browser prototype with design, split and code view, layers tree, responsive breakpoints, multi-file projects, ZIP export. No account needed.
- [Features](https://somnia.philipp-paulik.de/features/): every feature marked as working in the prototype or planned.
- [Planned pricing](https://somnia.philipp-paulik.de/pricing/): working pricing plan, not final, nothing for sale yet.
- [Compare](https://somnia.philipp-paulik.de/compare/): honest comparisons with Dreamweaver, Webflow, WordPress and Figma, plus Framer, Pinegrow, Bootstrap Studio and VS Code.
- [Compare: Framer](https://somnia.philipp-paulik.de/compare/framer-alternative/), [Pinegrow](https://somnia.philipp-paulik.de/compare/pinegrow-alternative/), [Bootstrap Studio](https://somnia.philipp-paulik.de/compare/bootstrap-studio-alternative/), [VS Code](https://somnia.philipp-paulik.de/compare/vscode-alternative/): fair comparisons that say where the other tool is the better choice.
- [For freelancers](https://somnia.philipp-paulik.de/for/freelancers/), [for agencies](https://somnia.philipp-paulik.de/for/agencies/), [for students](https://somnia.philipp-paulik.de/for/students/): what is planned for each audience and what works today.
- [Roadmap](https://somnia.philipp-paulik.de/roadmap/): phases 0 to 5, no dates promised.
- [Oneiroi AI layer](https://somnia.philipp-paulik.de/features/ai/): planned AI that sees the canvas and shows diffs. Not built.
- [Migrate from Dreamweaver](https://somnia.philipp-paulik.de/migrate/): what opens today and what is not supported.
- [FAQ](https://somnia.philipp-paulik.de/faq/): short answers about status, pricing and AI.

## Key facts

- Exists today: browser prototype, in-place text editing, drag and drop, shared undo, tablet/mobile overrides as real media queries, local folder open and save (Chromium only).
- Does not exist yet: native desktop app, AI layer (Oneiroi), Tailwind/Bootstrap/React/Vue support, extension SDK, pricing, downloads.
- Design targets (not measured yet): installer under 10 MB, cold start under 800 ms, idle memory under 80 MB.
- Principle: plain HTML, CSS and JS files on your disk, no project format, no lock-in.
- Roadmap: Phase 0 foundation (live), Phase 1 core WYSIWYG (closed alpha), Phase 2 frameworks and polish (public beta), Phase 3 professional features, Phase 4-5 launch.
